source:
@@U04621@@
(Solo.)

@@U04622@@
Who has built this house so vilely,
With shovel, pick, and spade?

@@U04624@@
For you, dull guest, in hempen vest,
This house was too well made.

@@U04626@@
(Solo.)

@@U04627@@
Who was it decked the hall so badly?
Chairs, tables, are there any?

@@U04629@@
It was loaned, not to be owned;
The creditors are many.

@@U04631@@
There lies the corpse.
If it tries to flee I'll simply whip out
the blood-signed document.
Ah, but you never know.
There are many ways of outwitting the Devil.
They'd steal a soul right from under my nose.
Our old ways are passé,
the new ones haven't caught on yet;
besides,
in the old days I'd have done this solo,
today I need accomplices.
This isn’t the best of times for devils.
Tradition, custom, ancient privileges,
gone with the wind!
What can you trust these days?
Time was, when a man breathed his last,
swoosh!
out slipped the soul like a mouse on the run,
and I like any old self-respecting feline
translation:
@@U04621@@
（独奏。）

@@U04622@@
是谁把这座房子建得如此卑鄙，
用铲子、镐和铁锹？

@@U04624@@
为你，迟钝的客人，穿着麻背心，
这房子建得太精良了。

@@U04626@@
（独奏。）

@@U04627@@
是谁把大厅布置得这么糟糕？
椅子，桌子，有吗？

@@U04629@@
它是借来的，不是用来拥有的；
债权人很多。

@@U04631@@
那儿躺着尸体。
如果它试图逃跑我就会直接抽走
血签名的文件。
啊，但你永远不知道。
智胜魔鬼的方法有很多种。
他们会在我眼皮子底下偷走一个灵魂。
我们的老方法已经过时了，
新的还没有流行起来；
此外，
以前我会独自完成这个，
今天我需要同伙。
对于魔鬼来说，这不是最好的时代。
传统、习俗、古老的特权，
随风而去！
如今你能相信什么？
时间是，当一个人咽下最后一口气时，
嗖！
灵魂像逃跑的老鼠一样溜走了，
我喜欢任何有自尊心的老猫
